integrity: The complete finite classification is generated by exact arithmetic over Q(sqrt(5)); all 4096 vertex masks are enumerated; a separate floating-point convex-hull implementation provides a non-proof consistency check.
scientific_limitations: Finite classification only, for fixed regular icosahedral vertices.
Independent equal-probability vertex retention is the probabilistic model.
Historical priority provisional; the full published four-vertex census text was not accessible.
No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Complete volume spectrum and Bernoulli-thinning law of a regular icosahedron
